items.headline: Holders ~27% underwater — and still not selling
items.detail: MVRV 0.73: price is 27% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.479). Yet 55% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving.
items.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
items.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

items.headline: SPX's MVRV 0.73 = 2th percentile of Bitcoin's history
items.detail: SPX's MVRV of 0.73 sits at the 2th percentile of Bitcoin's entire MVRV history — as cheap as BTC's generational bottoms.
items.framing: MVRV is unitless, so it's comparable: SPX today is at BTC's 2th percentile. BTC was only this cheap at major bottoms.
items.note: A position on BTC's map, not a date-match forecast.

items.headline: 11.43M SPX left in a day at a loss

items.framing: A loss-led exit wave — the worrying kind: 24 wallets left 11.43M SPX underwater. Say "left/dropped below the bar", not "dumped".

items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 13th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 46 while the rest average 17 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 46/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: NUPL -0.36 — capitulation

items.headline: 80% of all-time holders are gone — 92% of today's never sold to zero

items.framing: Enormous all-time churn, but the survivors are diamond-handed. The honest "who's still here" read.
items.note: Right-censoring: recent cohorts read high. "Gone" = fell below the 5k bar.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-17.3% over 12w)

items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-17.3% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.
